stemMd: What problem did the first review identify?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every team used exactly the same terms.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The office had stopped producing reports.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Inconsistent descriptions caused some relevant documents to be missed.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Paper folders were searched automatically by the new system.

explanationMd: Different labels for similar subjects created retrieval gaps. The example contrasts annual water use with yearly consumption. The problem was descriptive inconsistency, not universal loss of files.

distractorRationale.e: Familiar documents were easy to retrieve.
distractorRationale.d: The archive had replaced shared paper folders.
distractorRationale.a: The problem arose from varied names.
distractorRationale.b: Reports remained part of the archive.
